title: Viva Glint: configure a data retention policy for survey data
notes: claim 42: severity major on a rationale: impact rating lowered to minor; ratings are judgements and cannot hold a page
summary: The retention setting, navigation paths, default, retention limits and licensing statements are supported. The claim that employees see no change is unconfirmed, and the administrator-assignment statement should acknowledge Microsoft's separately documented support-user route.

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: Viva Glint has a Data retention policy control for deciding how long an instance keeps survey data.
claims.quote: Use the Data retention policy control to define the data retention policy for your Glint instance.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Scope; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The roadmap describes Glint service administrators configuring retention for their instances based on organisational policies.
claims.quote: This feature will introduce the capability for Glint service administrators to configure a data retention policy for their Glint instances based on the organizational policies.

claims.where: What's changing; Scope
claims.claim: The roadmap includes past engagement, always-on, lifecycle and 360 survey cycles in the retention configuration.
claims.quote: Any past survey cycles including engagement surveys, always-on surveys, lifecycle surveys and 360s will be retained/deleted based on this data retention configuration period.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; controls[1].governs; Governance controls
claims.claim: Service Admins own the Viva Glint app and have access to all administrative functionality, including the retention setting.
claims.quote: Users in this role are the "owners" of the Viva Glint app, having access to all administrative functionality and all survey data within the app.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: Microsoft recommends typically assigning no more than five Service Admins.
claims.quote: At least one Service Admin is required, and typically no more than 5 users assigned to this role is recommended.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: Only Microsoft 365 Global Administrators or Viva Glint Tenant Administrators can add or remove Service Admins, through the Microsoft 365 admin center.
claims.quote: Users can only be added/removed to this role by a Microsoft 365 Global Administrator or a Viva Glint Tenant Administrator from the Microsoft 365 Admin Center.
claims.fix: Qualify this statement wherever repeated as applying to employee Service Admin assignments. Add: 'Support users follow a separate Viva Glint application procedure, where the Service Admin User Role is selected by default; Microsoft says not to assign them through the Microsoft 365 admin center.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/viva/glint/setup/add-external-user, which states 'The Service Admin User Role is selected by default' and 'Don't assign support users to the Viva Glint Service Admin role through the Microsoft 365 admin center.'
